items.exampleEn: The mortar in this ancient wall has lasted for almost two thousand years.
items.exampleZh: 這道古牆裡的灰泥已經撐了將近兩千年。

items.exampleEn: In the story, the cat climbed up the chimney and got covered in black dust.
items.exampleZh: 故事裡，那隻貓爬上煙囪，弄得全身都是黑灰。

items.exampleEn: Bats often sleep high up among the rafters of old barns.
items.exampleZh: 蝙蝠常常睡在舊穀倉高處的椽木之間。

items.exampleEn: The pet shop sells leashes in many colors and sizes.
items.exampleZh: 那家寵物店賣各種顏色和尺寸的牽繩。

items.exampleEn: In the museum, we saw a stone ax made thousands of years ago.
items.exampleZh: 我們在博物館看到一把幾千年前做的石斧。

items.exampleEn: There is a row of pegs on the wall for the children's school bags.
items.exampleZh: 牆上有一排掛釘，讓孩子們掛書包。

items.exampleEn: Before electricity, many families read by the light of kerosene lamps.
items.exampleZh: 在有電以前，很多家庭靠煤油燈的光看書。

items.exampleEn: Most pallets in factories are made of wood or plastic.
items.exampleZh: 工廠裡的棧板大多是木頭或塑膠做的。

items.sentenceEn: Please keep your dog on a leash near the playground.
items.sentenceZh: 在遊樂場附近，請用牽繩牽好你的狗。

items.audioEn: The workers will move the boxes on wooden pallets with a machine tomorrow morning.
items.audioZh: 工人明天早上會用機器把放在木棧板上的箱子搬走。
items.questionZh: 工人什麼時候會搬箱子？

items.sentenceEn: Smoke was rising from the chimney of the little house.
items.sentenceZh: 煙從那間小房子的煙囪裡冒出來。

items.sentenceEn: She hung the wet towels on the line with wooden pegs.
items.sentenceZh: 她用木頭衣夾把濕毛巾晾在繩子上。

items.stemEn: The workers filled the gaps between the bricks with ____.
items.stemZh: 工人用灰泥填滿磚塊之間的縫隙。

items.stemEn: The camping stove runs on ____, so we brought an extra bottle.
items.stemZh: 這個露營爐用煤油，所以我們多帶了一瓶。

items.passageEn: My aunt and uncle bought an old house in the country and are slowly repairing it. First, they cleaned the chimney so they could safely light the fireplace again. Then my uncle climbed up to check the rafters, which were still strong after a hundred years. In the yard, he used an ax to cut up fallen trees, while my aunt mixed mortar to fix the stone walls. Wooden pallets of new roof tiles are waiting by the gate. In a cupboard, they found an old kerosene lamp, which now hangs on a peg in the kitchen. Their dog, freed from its leash, runs happily around the fields, following every new scent.
items.passageZh: 阿姨和叔叔在鄉下買了一棟老房子，正在慢慢整修。首先，他們清理了煙囪，好讓壁爐能再次安全地生火。接著叔叔爬上去檢查椽木，一百年過去了，它們依然很堅固。在院子裡，叔叔用斧頭劈倒下的樹，阿姨則調灰泥修補石牆。一個個木棧板的新屋瓦正堆在門口等著。他們在櫥櫃裡找到一盞舊煤油燈，現在掛在廚房的掛鉤上。他們的狗解開了牽繩，開心地在田野裡跑來跑去，追著每一種新氣味。

questions.questionZh: 他們為什麼先清理煙囪？
options: 為了能安全地在壁爐生火

questions.questionZh: 那盞舊煤油燈現在在哪裡？

items.promptZh: 我們用舊棧板做了一張花園長椅。
referenceEn: We made a garden bench out of old pallets.
We used old pallets to build a bench for the garden.
rubricZh: pallet 指棧板（例如 old pallets）
「做」可寫 make、build 等；時態合理即可（例如 made、have made）

items.promptZh: 那隻小狗咬斷了牽繩跑掉了。
referenceEn: The puppy bit through its leash and ran away.
The little dog chewed through its leash and ran off.
rubricZh: leash 指「狗的牽繩」（例如 its leash 等）
「咬斷」可寫，例如 bit through、chewed through 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 bit、has run away 等）；動物可用 it、he、she 指稱
